title: Group send with no members stores orphaned-pending message (no delivery path)
description: If get_members returns an empty list (group chat with zero members), insert_outbound_message is called with an empty outbox_peers slice. The message is written to the DB with delivery_state='pending' and no outbox rows. The outbox retry loop will never pick it up. The owner gets a success response and sees the message stuck in Pending forever. The new doc comment explicitly calls this 'valid (no delivery scheduled)', which may prevent a future fix. Scenario that triggers the cost: user creates a group chat and sends before adding any members. Maintenance consequence: 'message stuck pending' issue reports with no obvious cause, since the DB state is consistent (no error, just no outbox entry).
